name: 65536 · Lebanon, MO
findings: ZIP 65536 (Lebanon) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65536 (Lebanon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 65536 (Lebanon) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
